hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *HTML設計稿/*.html) d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ] && [ ! -f "$d/Spec/.convert_tools/mockup_lint.py" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ -f "$d/Spec/.convert_tools/mockup_lint.py" ]; then python3 "$d/Spec/.convert_tools/mockup_lint.py" --file "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
